_scenario: TRANSIENT FAILURE — WMS temporarily down (connection timeout / 500)
_notes: Use this payload with the WMS mock when the mock is stopped or configured to return HTTP 500. The wms-soap-dispatcher will retry 3× with exponential back-off (5s, 30s, 120s). After exhausting retries the message moves to the dead-letter queue and the dlq-monitor workflow emits a DLQ_ALERT_SUMMARY on the next 15-minute cycle. Expected outcome at APIM: 202 Accepted immediately (fire-and-forget ingress). Expected outcome in Log Analytics: WMS_SOAP_FAULT events, then message appears on Service Bus DLQ.
